text:
sam_marketing: Heads-up  partner accidentally published a short mention of our upcoming benchmark 1hr before our scheduled embargo. They used a one-line blurb on their blog and an X thread. Need immediate coordination: correction? escalate? quick talking points? @jonathan_pr @legal_kate @press_ops @ceo_anna

jonathan_pr: Oh no. Do we have a screenshot or permalink? Can we ask them to unpublish or add an editor's note?

cecilia_partner: link: https://partner.example/teasers/redwood-bench (they posted a short blurb, no numbers). Partner claims it was a scheduling error and they're willing to add an editor note or rollback.

legal_kate: If they rollback that's simplest. If not, request an editor note clarifying it's a teaser and subject to embargo. Also we need a signed attestation that no data was shared.

press_ops: Meanwhile I'm pausing scheduled outreach and notifying top-tier reporters to hold. If partner refuses to remove, we should prepare an official "pre-release" FAQ and decide if we accelerate our own publish.

sam_marketing: Quick decision needed: ask partner to rollback OR move our publish up by 30-60 minutes and lift embargo. Pros/cons?

elaine: If we move up, ops needs 30m to validate links, image CDN, and scheduled socials. We can probably shift to +30m. But that shortens PR prep time.

ceo_anna: If partner rollback is possible, prefer that to maintain our narrative control. But willing to move if rollback denied. My ask: what do reporters see now? Any incorrect claims?

jonathan_pr: They didn't include numbers, just said "new benchmark shows major efficiency gains." That's vague but could be misinterpreted. Request rollback + correction ASAP.

cecilia_partner: I asked partner to unpublish immediately; they're checking with their editor. ETA 10m. They've also offered to put an editor's note linking to our embargo and stating they jumped the gun.

legal_kate: Good. Ask them to keep screenshots/logs of what was shared and confirm nothing from our internal repo was exposed. We need that for audit.

press_ops: Preparing two paths: (A) rollback accepted -> continue with our schedule; (B) partner won't rollback -> accelerate publish and send reactive note. Drafts for both ready.

oliver_social: If we accelerate, I need final blog copy and assets within 20m to queue socials. Otherwise I'll hold. Also recommend we avoid repeating partner's teaser phrasing to prevent amplifying it.

sam_marketing: I'll coordinate with partner and get them to rollback. Also prepping a short "live" post if we move up.

press_ops: FYI I've alerted three priority reporters to hold; told them we'll update in 15m. Keeping tone neutral.

jonathan_pr: If partner adds an editor's note, request they link to our upcoming blog and include this line: "This mention was published in error and is subject to an embargo; official details will be released by Redwood Inference at [time]."

cecilia_partner: Partner confirmed rollback. They removed the live post and will add an editor's note in the archive. They apologized.

legal_kate: Upload the partner confirmation and any screenshots to PR compliance folder. Marking legal satisfied for now.

sam_marketing: OK team: we're back on schedule. Final checklist: 1) Elaine validate CMS hooks + set publish 30 min out, 2) Oliver finalize socials, 3) Press_ops stand by to send live note at publish, 4) Jonathan prep reactive Qs for reporters, 5) Legal archive partner confirmation.

elaine: CMS verified, images cached, publish slot confirmed at original time + 0 (no change). I will monitor during publish.

oliver_social: Socials queued for original times. Holding until Sam posts live.

press_ops: Ready to send embargo lift to press list at +1 minute post publish. Drafted email included screenshots and links.

jonathan_pr: I'll prepare a short embargoed brief for top analysts and the CEO quote. Ready on my side.

ceo_anna: Drafted quote: "Transparency matters. We're excited to share our benchmark and methodology so teams can evaluate performance for themselves." Approve?

legal_kate: CEO quote looks fine. No product claims. Approved. :white_check_mark:

sam_marketing: Publishing now. Live: https://redwood.in/blog/benchmark-release. Posting live message here.

oliver_social: Socials are live. Short X posted and pinned.

press_ops: Press email sent to embargo list. A few reporters replied requesting deeper data access  forwarding to Alex/research.

jonathan_pr: Great work. Closing loop: partner rollback confirmed, legal archived proof, blog and socials live, press outreach in flight. Any follow-ups?

cecilia_partner: Partner sent a note to their editor apologizing publicly and linking to our blog. They apologized to their readers.

sam_marketing: Thanks everyone. Filing this thread and uploading all artifacts to /PR/edits/1987654321. Moving to monitoring phase for coverage. :tada:
